## Frequently asked questions about JFK to PEK

 How long is the flight from New York (JFK) to Beijing (PEK)? 

 CA 982 is scheduled at 16h 45m from New York (JFK) to Beijing (PEK) on every departure in the schedule table on this page. The nonstop covers about 6,821 miles, and airlines adjust scheduled times by season, so confirm with the airline before you book. 

 Which airlines fly nonstop from JFK to PEK? 

 Air China is currently the only airline flying JFK to PEK nonstop. 2LNR doesn't show award or upgrade space for it on JFK to PEK, so this page carries the schedule rather than a space claim. 

 How many flights a week are there from JFK to PEK? 

 About 5 nonstop flights a week run between New York (JFK) and Beijing (PEK) in the current schedule, operated by Air China. Frequency shifts by season, and the schedule table on this page shows what is scheduled next. 

 What time do flights from JFK to PEK depart? 

 In the next 7 days with service, every scheduled JFK to PEK nonstop leaves at 01:05 local time at New York. The schedule table on this page lists each departure by date. 

 Which flights operate JFK to PEK nonstop? 

 Air China flies CA 982 nonstop from New York (JFK) to Beijing (PEK), the only flight number in the schedule table on this page. The table lists each date with its departure and arrival times and aircraft. 

 Does 2LNR show upgrade or award space on JFK to PEK? 

 Not on this route: 2LNR doesn't show award or upgrade space for Air China on JFK to PEK. The page carries the full JFK to PEK nonstop schedule and who flies each departure, and the reverse direction is linked below.
